instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief: CedarVale Award Review manages grant application intake, eligibility review, proposal review, budget review, and final award decisions. Applicants submit packages; Program Officers check eligibility; eligible applications go to two Reviewers who add comments; Finance Officers review budgets after proposal reviews are complete; Award Approvers record final decisions; and approved applicants receive notices. The eligibility criteria, reviewer-selection role, budget-revision actor, notice channel, and acceptable notice-delivery time remain undecided. Reviewers said applicants should see comments immediately, but Award Approvers said comments must remain hidden until the final decision is recorded.

output.summary: CedarVale Award Review manages grant application intake, eligibility review, proposal review, budget review, and final award decisions. Applicants, Program Officers, Reviewers, Finance Officers, and Award Approvers participate in the workflow, including approval notices for approved applicants. Several operating details remain undecided, and the permitted timing of applicant access to reviewer comments is conflicting.
output.primary_goal: Manage grant application intake, eligibility review, proposal review, budget review, and final award decisions.
key_capabilities: Route eligible applications to two Reviewers
Review proposed budgets after proposal reviews are complete
unresolved_points: The role that selects the two Reviewers is undecided.
The actor responsible for budget revision is undecided.
The acceptable approval-notice delivery time is undecided.
Applicant access to reviewer comments is conflicting: immediate access was requested, while another statement requires comments to remain hidden until the final decision is recorded.

instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Discovery notes: The project is CedarVale Award Review, intended to manage grant application intake, eligibility review, proposal review, budget review, and final award decisions. An Applicant submits an application package and receives a notice if the application is approved. The Program Officer checks submitted applications for eligibility. Two Reviewers receive each eligible application and add comments. The Finance Officer reviews the proposed budget only after proposal reviews are complete. The Award Approver records the final decision. The workflow also returns an unacceptable budget for revision. The eligibility criteria, the role selecting the Reviewers, the actor revising an unacceptable budget, the approval-notice channel, the acceptable notice-delivery time, and when Applicants may first view reviewer comments are unresolved.

output.business_objective: Manage grant application intake, eligibility review, proposal review, budget review, and final award decisions.
